content:
deploy-bot: Deploy started — canary rollout initiated for service: inference-api
env: prod-usw
tag: release/2026-03-20-v2.3.1-canary
commit: a1b2c3d6
sample: 3% traffic (goal 10m)
checks: latency_p95,error_rate,smoke:basic
Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/canary-checklist :rocket:

maria: Watching dashboards. I’ll call out any red flags.

chen: Copy. Do we need to pin the model binary for this rollout to avoid autosync drift?

oliver: Also FYI routing override set to region prod-usw only for this canary.

oncall-bot: Alert: inference-api-canary p95 latency increased to 480ms (threshold 450ms) — see https://graph.redwood/inference-api/canary/1748507654

maria: Saw the spike. Error rate still < 0.5%. Looks like KV-cache warmups on a subset of pods. Monitoring the 5m windows.

deploy-bot: Canary health summary: 1 failed probe (kv cache), 2 warnings (latency spike), overall pass criteria: true (error_rate < 1%).

chen: Let’s hold promotion until we have two consecutive 5m windows stable. Also pin the deployment to commit a1b2c3d6 so nothing else drifts in while we observe.

oliver: How do we pin from the console/cli?

maria: Use the control-plane pin endpoint, e.g.:
```
curl -X POST \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $DEPLOY_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  https://api.redwood.internal/v1/deploys/pin \
  -d '{"service":"inference-api","env":"prod-usw","commit":"a1b2c3d6","reason":"canary hold - cache warmup"}'
```

chen: Executed pin command.

deploy-bot: Pin applied: deployment pinned to release/2026-03-20-v2.3.1-canary (a1b2c3d6). No auto-promote while pinned.

sre-ops: Recommendation: promote to 20% for 30m (step-up) to gather more load and validate tail behavior.

chen: Agree. Promote to 20% now.

deploy-bot: Canary update: traffic adjusted to 20% (promote step 2/4). Rolling adjust across lanes.
deploy-bot: Smoke checks: passed 10m window after step. No new errors. Continuing observation.

maria: Running eval set against canary prompts now. Will post summary in ~15m.

maria: Quick eval note: small quality regression on one prompt — ~2 token difference in output length/format, within our threshold. No semantic regressions found so far.

oliver: p95 latency back to baseline after step-up, and eval looks fine. +1 to continue promote. :thumbsup:

chen: OK. Initiating final promote to 100%.

deploy-bot: Promotion started — rolling to 100% across prod-usw over ~12m.
tag: release/2026-03-20-v2.3.1
commit: a1b2c3d6
PR: https://git.redwood/repo/pulls/1428

deploy-bot: Promotion complete. All canaries promoted. No active rollbacks.
Release note: pinned model v2.3.1-quantized; route consistency enforced. :tada:

maria: Nice. I’ll open a short follow-up if the eval regression worsens, otherwise will close monitoring in 2 hours.

chen: Adding deployment tag: deployment-pin:release-2026-03-20 for audit.

oliver: Great work team.
